jobs.name: 束风露额
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a nine-layer Chinese cultivation character portrait. Reference image is OUR OWN existing art: use exactly its warm charcoal black hair, restrained warm grey fibre highlights, fine matte ink-wash strand rendering, hand-painted detail density, calm lighting, no gloss. NOT photorealistic, not anime flat shading. Strict orthographic FRONT view, level camera, centred head axis, no yaw, no tilted skull. Compact natural crown (no tall dome or flattened wide cap), realistic width and hairline. ONLY draw the requested isolated HAIR layer on real TRANSPARENT alpha, crisp fine transparent flyaways, no background, shadow, glow, paper rectangle, face, skin, ears, eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, neck, clothes or mannequin. The haircut can naturally overlap ear positions, never carve ear-shaped outlines or holes.
Subject: Male practical cultivator: carefully combed straight backward hair, no centre split; shallow natural M hairline, clear forehead, close-fitting temples, small short pointed sideburns ending at ear level, no long cheek or chest locks.
Layer ownership: FRONT hair includes only front scalp cap, hairline, short temples and any specified cheek-facing locks. Interior below hairline must be transparent. Absolutely exclude back hair, ponytail, rear buns and back-of-body hanging hair. Place compact cap in upper-middle of a portrait canvas, with ample padding. Hairline and temples remain frontal and fit the reference face proportions.
